answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with slashing. Each agent locks a bond to register; voting power scales with stake, not headcount. To fake thousands of identities, an attacker must fund every bond, and any proven sybil cluster loses its stake entirely. Honest agents reach the summit of influence only through sustained accurate work, while the attacker's costs rise from a trickle to a glacier and then a nebula of capital, making mass fake identities economically irrational. The Agent0221 deployment anchors trust at Qsih4aEbSV.
